lines.t: Steel sky rip, whole cosmos flinch when His war-step hit that line
Eyes like judgment, cloak like storm, every false throne out of time
He roll in, no escort needed, whole host move when He just incline
Voice like thunder in the marrow of men, drag secrets out the crooked spine
Blood on the ground from the saints they mocked, every tear on His ledger in flame
He call case file, read charges raw, every opp gotta own that shame
You loved bloodshed, now drink that cup; you sold kids for your god of lust
You built towers off the backs of the poor, ground crack, swallow all that trust
You preached peace while you sharpened the blade, played church while you pimped His name
Now the very Name you merchandised up come back as a war cry, flame
Hands off steel, hands in chains, when the King step down, no deals
Every knee break, every tongue confess, feel the crush of the One that’s real
This that verdict, not no drill, this that gavel of the Great I AM
YAHUWAH rule, YahuShua judge, Boss of all bosses, no man can stand
YAHUWAH rule, YahuShua judge, Boss of all bosses, no man can stand
He list out charges:
Lust of the flesh, you filmed it and sold it, called bondage “free” online
Widow in the dark, you drained her last, then laughed at her faith as “blind”
Hands full of blood from the unborn slain, you framed it as “choice” and “care”
You crowned yourself god over life and breath, now choke on the same thin air
You traded truth for a scholar’s clout, mocked Scripture as “stone-age law”
You called good evil, evil good, now quake ‘cause you stand in the Judge’s awe
You trafficked souls, ran kids like product, marked passports with secret sin
He crack one seal, whole ring exposed, every handler, every kingpin
No more talking points, no spin room, no team to coach your lie
Only blazing eyes, books wide, and a Lamb you can’t deny
He the Alpha charge, Omega sentence, Warrior robed in red
Voice that formed all worlds now say one word, whole line of tyrants dead
Hands off steel, hands in chains, when the King step down, no deals
Every knee break, every tongue confess, feel the crush of the One that’s real
This that verdict, not no drill, this that gavel of the Great I AM
YAHUWAH rule, YahuShua judge, Boss of all bosses, no man can stand
